objective: Bind confirmed-exit admission fences, UI surfacing, and WorkflowObservationBinding sources to the exact run incarnation.
required_change: Key admission exit fences and scheduler surfaced/pending/in-flight exit state by exact owner run incarnation plus six-field identity. A->None->the same A must start without the old exit fence or surfaced UI state.

Introduce an owner-issued exit-source token (or equivalent) bound under lock to identity+incarnation. Any external exit notification, including WorkflowObservationBinding, must present this token; fence_exit validates it under the same lock. An old token racing with or arriving after a new incarnation must fail without fencing or surfacing the new run.

WorkflowObservationBinding may attach to freeze the persisted WorkflowRun identity, but it must explicitly bind once to the scheduler/admission current incarnation before collect_and_notify. It must not silently rebind an old WorkflowRun instance to a later same-identity incarnation. Update the actual runtime composition accordingly.
Internal current-run fact exits must capture the current incarnation before any blocking callback and validate it at fence linearization.

Keep terminal fence separate from UI retry: old-incarnation callback retry may complete once, but never changes the new incarnation's review state; new incarnation may review at its own 60-second boundary.
Add tests for exit->A-None-A reset, old exit callback racing replacement, old binding/token after replacement, pending UI retry across replacement, idempotent A, and independent new-incarnation exit.
verification: Rerun current actual OMP 18.2.10 probe using the bound production WorkflowObservationBinding path.
constraints: apply_patch only; no workflow records, uv/local env/package artifacts, destructive git actions, or graphify restore.
